name: dsh-task-management
description: Configurable, host-mounted durable task management for DeepSeek Harness

scripts.build: npm run build -w @dsh-task/typed-decisions && npm run build -w @dsh-task/task-system && npm run build -w @dsh-task/remote-execution && npm run build -w @dsh-task/feishu-channel
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:native && npm run test:legacy
scripts.test:legacy: node --test tests/legacy/readers.test.mjs tests/legacy/reporting.test.mjs tests/legacy/quota.test.mjs tests/legacy/compatibility.test.mjs tests/legacy/configured-sources.test.mjs tests/legacy/ad-hoc.test.mjs tests/legacy/diagnostics.test.mjs
